CREATE TABLE pc_atomic_memory_idempotency (
	namespace_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	digest_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	request_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (namespace_digest), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_idempotency_digest_version CHECK (digest_version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_idempotency_revision CHECK (revision > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_idempotency_state_version CHECK (state_version >= 0)
)
